description: This file defines the OX_Admin_UI_Event_EventDispatcher class, which manages event listeners and dispatches events within the Revive Adserver project. It includes methods for registering listeners, retrieving registered listeners, triggering events, and handling dynamic method calls for event notifications.

classes.name: OX_Admin_UI_Event_EventDispatcher
classes.description: A singleton class managing event listeners and dispatching events to registered callbacks.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the dispatcher.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a callback as a listener for a specific event name.

methods.name: getRegisteredListeners
methods.description: Retrieves all registered listeners for a given event.

methods.name: triggerEvent
methods.description: Notifies all listeners registered for a specific event, passing the event context.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for a callback to prevent duplicate registrations.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic method calls starting with 'on' to trigger corresponding events.
